Question: Assalamualikum.. Ye daroode taj aaya kahase , koi hadith me hai ya phir aaise hi kisi ne banaya hai? kya sahi hai? Answer ID: 12033 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 801/667=D/1430) The Durood-e-Taj is not proved by any hadith, it was invented by anyone centuries after the Prophet (peace be upon him). It is bid?ah and deviation to read this durood. It contains some words of shirk which may affect the beliefs of people. Therefore, it is prohibited to recite it and keep it in shops and houses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
